integrity: The stated proof is symbolic; a pure-Python checker tests finite fields of orders 3,9,27 and a subset over 81. No independent audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: The claims concern the singular characteristic-three reductions and their elliptic or rational normalizations, not genus-four superspecial Jacobians. The coefficient count is not a moduli count. Possible unindexed priority remains.
title: Characteristic-three collapse and exact zeta strata of a genus-four \(C_6\) hyperelliptic pencil
